what: xvmec reset=<wout> (VMEC2000 70c637a, PARVMEC 9.0 build on office) as a hot start: iteration-1 FSQR FSQZ FSQL of the first force pass on solovev_symmetric NS17 (tcon0 1, NITER 2)
